_comment: Things that block the way until the right tool clears them. Place in Tiled as 'obstacle' objects covering whole tiles (property 'obstacle' = id). They come back every time the area reloads. 'requires' is an item tag (see items.json); 'hits' is how many swings it takes.

bush.name: Thorny Bush
bush.hint: Thick thorny growth. Something sharp could cut through it.

rock.name: Boulder
rock.hint: A heavy boulder. A pickaxe could break it.
